option_relations.rationale: Infectious endophthalmitis is a broader category that includes endophthalmitis caused by Streptococcus intermedius
Polymicrobial bacterial iris abscess matches the description of the condition, including the presence of Streptococcus intermedius and another unidentified gram-positive bacillus
Fungal endophthalmitis is not supported by the gram stain results, which showed gram-positive cocci and rods
Endogenous endophthalmitis with iris abscess is not directly related to the provided information, which suggests an exogenous source of infection
